wippy.description: Mount <kickside-jobs-admin> to edit Jobs worker counts, queue fairness, lease timing, retry delays and execution limits. It reads and writes /api/v1/jobs/policy through the host API bridge, shows default/host/admin sources, supports per-field resets, and refreshes pool status on Jobs invalidations and host visibility. A committed save can remain pending application while existing executions retain their captured policy. The optional config object is accepted for Settings block mounting; no config fields are currently required.

config.description: Opaque Settings mount configuration; no fields are required.
